title: ACTIVE RELOAD
why: His idea: "maybe reload can be a bar that goes halfway with like a sweet spot and if the player hits reload again during the sweet spot it adds the damage and finishes the reload instantly". The ring that fills round your cursor while you reload now has a bright stretch on it, the sweet spot, from 42 to 60 percent of the reload. Press R again while the ring is inside it and the reload finishes at once, the next magazine does 15 percent more damage, and a ping and a green flash say so. Press too early or too late and nothing happens: the reload goes on at its normal speed, with no jam and no penalty. Holding R from the start does not count, so you have to let go and press again. The bonus ends when the magazine is empty, at the next reload or when you change gun.
now: Press R again in the bright stretch of the reload ring to finish it at once and add 15 percent damage to the next magazine.
